$comment: Per-character animation overrides — the canonical source of truth for which character-baked GLB plays for each AnimName slot. Maintained by scripts/mixamo/add-anim-everywhere.ts and scripts/mixamo/fetch-animations.ts; safe to edit by hand. Schema: { <animatorId>: { <AnimName>: '<url-path-to-glb>', ... }, ... }. animatorId matches the second arg of `new VRMCharacterAnimator(vrm, animatorId)`. Slot keys must match the AnimName type in vrm-character-animator.ts.

hermes-male.$comment: NO 'walk' key INTENTIONALLY: hermes-male (and Phanes, the default Hatcher avatar, which animates via animatorId 'hermes-male') uses the clean GLOBAL walk.glb (net -0.845 hips-Y, mostly cyclic). The per-character public/avatars/animations/hermes-male/walk.glb on disk is the OLD broken bake (+1.887 hips-Y drift/loop, dropped in commit 8fd93b32) — do NOT wire it as a 'walk' override here without verifying it plays in-place; PER_CHARACTER_IN_PLACE_CLIPS['hermes-male'] already lists 'walk' defensively so wiring it would strip positions and stay sink-safe. (Hatcher review FIX-15 / 3D-5.) Note: this $-prefixed key is inert — the loader only ever indexes this object by AnimName, never '$comment'.
